description: Voice-over records. Dialogue lines are matched at runtime by (speaker, exact text) so no engine ids are needed; `id` is for humans/tools. Empty until the ElevenLabs phase.

schema.speaker: HOLLIS | NARRATOR | INGRID ... (the speaker tag used in dialogue; NARRATOR for untagged lines)
schema.text: the exact dialogue text as shown on screen (without the 'SPEAKER: ' prefix)
schema.file: relative path under the project root, e.g. assets/audio/voice/hollis/vo_hollis_act6_warehouse_right.mp3
